cloud_new_directory.description: Entirely new cloud/ directory for relay server deployment

hunks.description: 92 insertions, 62 deletions. New dependencies added (30+), version bumps, workspace config changes.
46 insertions. Expanded workspace to include cloud/ packages (relay, relay-ops, relay-fence-broker, relay-contract, dev scripts).
14 insertions, 7 deletions. Build config updates for new modules and entry points.
31 insertions, 4 deletions. Expanded agent instructions and capabilities documentation.
8 insertions, 4 deletions. Updated project documentation.
12,780 insertions, 5,476 deletions. Massive expansion from 851KB to 1.6MB. New test contracts, coverage requirements, and quality gates.
335 deletions. Reduced from 17,919 to 844 bytes. Most line-count baselines removed.
Grew from 27,339 to 34,735 bytes. New build targets and packaging configuration.
Grew from 4,559 to 7,317 bytes. New TypeScript compilation targets for CLI modules.
Grew from 3,312 to 4,613 bytes. New ignore patterns for cloud/, relay, and new build artifacts.
Grew from 5,961 to 7,072 bytes. New linting rules for expanded codebase.
Grew from 1,990 to 2,586 bytes. New i18n coverage entries for new components.
Entirely new directory. Relay server (111 files), relay-ops (34), relay-fence-broker (13), relay-contract (20), terraform infra (23), dev scripts (117).
New skills system with 155 files for plugin/skill management.
Massive runtime system expansion with 1,139 new files.
424 new files added. Browser pane rebuilt with remote streaming, markup tools, annotation system.
Entirely new browser pane component tree: address bar, annotations, toolbar, remote browser streaming, markup tools, webview registry.
New source control panel: git history, PR creation, AI code review, branch management, bulk actions.
New combined diff viewer: file tree, section loading, scrollbar, commit message integration.
17 husky hook template files removed from upstream.
~60 browser pane files removed from baseline locations. Refactored to new component structure.
~40 shared utility files removed: GitHub utils, worktree management, Linear integration, types.
